overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when a technical failure prevented real-time streaming of its May 27, 2020 remote meeting, because the Executive Order's real-time exception requires economic hardship as well as best efforts.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by holding its May 27, 2020 remote meeting without providing the public real-time access after a technical livestream failure.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find a violation of the Open Meeting Law where the Board was unable to provide real-time access to the meeting only because of a technical issue, and not also because of economic hardship.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
